examples.en: She handed me a small packet of seeds.
examples.zh: 她递给我一小包种子。

examples.en: My grandmother is very fond of her cats.
examples.zh: 我祖母非常喜爱她的猫。

examples.en: His excuse for being late seemed quite questionable.
examples.zh: 他迟到的借口似乎相当可疑。

examples.en: A sales rep called me about the new phone.
examples.zh: 一位销售代表打电话向我介绍这款新手机。

examples.en: The farm produced a surplus of corn this year.
examples.zh: 今年这家农场生产了过剩的玉米。

examples.en: She answered every question with calm poise.
examples.zh: 她以镇定的姿态回答了每一个问题。

examples.en: They went to a counselor about their marital problems.
examples.zh: 他们去找咨询师处理婚姻问题。

examples.en: The dog gave a vicious bite to the stranger.
examples.zh: 那条狗恶狠狠地咬了陌生人一口。

examples.en: The magazine printed his photographic work last month.
examples.zh: 上个月这家杂志刊登了他的摄影作品。

examples.en: We ate homemade bread for breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我们吃了自制面包当早餐。

examples.zh: 这种柔软的布料垂坠得很漂亮。

examples.zh: 他们属于附近一个小型的福音派教会。

examples.zh: 一位女发言人解释了公司的新政策。

examples.en: He put a wedge under the door to keep it open.
examples.zh: 他在门下塞了一个楔子，让门保持打开。

examples.zh: 六个人把沉重的棺材抬到墓地。

examples.en: The little boy has sandy hair and blue eyes.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩有着浅黄褐色的头发和蓝色的眼睛。

examples.en: Everyone felt tense before the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考试前每个人都感到紧张。

examples.en: The archaeologist found old pottery near the river.
examples.zh: 考古学家在河边发现了古老的陶器。

examples.en: The loud noise caused a disturbance in the library.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音在图书馆里引起了扰乱。

examples.en: "Bigger" is the comparative form of "big".
examples.zh: “bigger”是“big”的比较级形式。

examples.en: She works for a large pharmaceutical company.
examples.zh: 她在一家大型制药公司工作。

examples.en: He reads books in his leisure time.
examples.zh: 他在空闲时间读书。

examples.en: The engineers built a prototype of the new car.
examples.zh: 工程师们制造了这款新车的原型。

examples.en: Thick vegetation covered the whole hillside.
examples.zh: 茂密的植物覆盖了整个山坡。

examples.en: The magnet picked up all the small nails.
examples.zh: 磁铁把所有的小钉子都吸了起来。

examples.en: Old cars often emit a lot of smoke.
examples.zh: 旧汽车常常排放大量的烟。

examples.en: He is just an acquaintance, not a close friend.
examples.zh: 他只是个相识的人，不是亲密的朋友。

examples.en: It was unusually cold for a spring morning.
examples.zh: 对于一个春天的早晨来说，天气异乎寻常地冷。

examples.en: She looked at the cheater with deep contempt.
examples.zh: 她带着深深的轻蔑看着那个骗子。

examples.en: The lender asked him to repay the money soon.
examples.zh: 贷款人要求他尽快还钱。

examples.en: Many farm workers only have seasonal jobs.
examples.zh: 许多农场工人只有季节性的工作。

examples.zh: 在古老的故事里，私生子不能继承王位。

examples.en: Doctors tested the efficacy of the new medicine.
examples.zh: 医生们检验了这种新药的功效。

examples.en: The anthropologist studied a remote mountain village.
examples.zh: 这位人类学家研究了一个偏远的山村。

examples.en: The children saw lions and pandas at the zoo.
examples.zh: 孩子们在动物园里看到了狮子和熊猫。

examples.en: The team showed clear dominance over its rivals.
examples.zh: 这支队伍对对手展现出明显的优势。

examples.en: There is ample room for everyone in the hall.
examples.zh: 大厅里有足够的空间容纳每个人。

examples.en: The famous theorist explained his new idea to students.
examples.zh: 这位著名的理论家向学生们解释了他的新观点。

examples.en: Being short can be a disadvantage in basketball.
examples.zh: 在篮球运动中，个子矮可能是个不利条件。

examples.en: The flag has red and white stripes.
examples.zh: 这面旗帜上有红白相间的条纹。

examples.en: Money can be a potent force in politics.
examples.zh: 在政治中，金钱可能是一股强大的力量。

examples.en: "What a beautiful view!" she exclaimed loudly.
examples.zh: “多美的景色啊！”她大声叫道。

examples.en: He placed the golf ball on the tee.
examples.zh: 他把高尔夫球放在球座上。

examples.en: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天和牙医有个预约。

examples.en: The fox hid its babies inside a warm den.
examples.zh: 狐狸把幼崽藏在一个温暖的洞穴里。

examples.en: Her eyes were full of sorrow at the funeral.
examples.zh: 在葬礼上，她的眼里满是悲伤。

examples.en: We ate fresh oysters by the sea.
examples.zh: 我们在海边吃了新鲜的牡蛎。

examples.en: The medicine may have some adverse effects.
examples.zh: 这种药可能有一些不良影响。

examples.en: City people sometimes laugh at the provincial visitor.
examples.zh: 城里人有时会嘲笑那位外地来的客人。

examples.en: He wrote a scholarly book about ancient China.
examples.zh: 他写了一本关于古代中国的学术著作。

examples.en: Don't exaggerate; the fish wasn't that big.
examples.zh: 别夸张了，那条鱼没那么大。

examples.en: She used a whisk to beat the eggs.
examples.zh: 她用搅拌器打鸡蛋。

examples.en: The bakery sells fresh pastry every morning.
examples.zh: 这家面包店每天早上都卖新鲜的油酥点心。

examples.en: His goal was the decisive moment of the match.
examples.zh: 他的进球是这场比赛的决定性时刻。

examples.en: The nuclear reactor produces electricity for the city.
examples.zh: 这座核反应堆为城市供电。

examples.en: My sister will turn seventeen next week.
examples.zh: 我姐姐下周就满十七岁了。

examples.en: The chart makes the data easier to understand visually.
examples.zh: 这张图表使数据在视觉上更容易理解。

examples.en: The volcano erupted and sent ash into the sky.
examples.zh: 火山喷发了，把火山灰喷向天空。

examples.en: He felt jealous when she talked to other boys.
examples.zh: 当她和别的男孩说话时，他感到嫉妒。

examples.en: Scientists study the molecular structure of water.
examples.zh: 科学家们研究水的分子结构。

examples.en: We walked under a stone arch into the garden.
examples.zh: 我们从一个石拱门下走进花园。

examples.en: The cows are grazing in the green pasture.
examples.zh: 牛群正在绿色的牧场上吃草。

examples.en: The people started a rebellion against the cruel king.
examples.zh: 人民发起了反抗残暴国王的叛乱。

examples.en: The new law is popular in his constituency.
examples.zh: 这项新法律在他的选区很受欢迎。

examples.en: He chuckled quietly at the funny joke.
examples.zh: 他听到这个有趣的笑话，轻声地笑了。

examples.en: Many strange birds live in the swamp.
examples.zh: 许多奇特的鸟生活在这片沼泽里。

examples.en: He made a quick dash to catch the bus.
examples.zh: 他猛地一冲去赶公交车。

examples.en: The view from the mountain top was awesome.
examples.zh: 从山顶看到的景色令人惊叹。

examples.en: She is a proud lesbian and an activist.
examples.zh: 她是一位自豪的女同性恋者和活动家。

examples.en: He was evidently tired after the long trip.
examples.zh: 经过长途旅行后，他显然很累。

examples.en: His rude comment was a deliberate insult.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的话是故意的侮辱。

examples.en: Harry Potter is a famous fictional character.
examples.zh: 哈利·波特是一个著名的虚构人物。

examples.en: The fisherman put a worm on his hook as bait.
examples.zh: 渔夫把一条虫子挂在鱼钩上做饵。

examples.en: This dictionary explains the correct usage of each word.
examples.zh: 这本词典解释了每个单词的正确用法。

examples.en: The famous novelist signed copies of her new book.
examples.zh: 这位著名的小说家为她的新书签名。

examples.en: My legs were sore after the long run.
examples.zh: 长跑之后我的腿很酸痛。

examples.en: The test measures anxiety on a separate subscale.
examples.zh: 这项测试在一个单独的分量表上测量焦虑。

examples.en: Colorful fish swim around the coral reef.
examples.zh: 色彩斑斓的鱼在珊瑚礁周围游动。

examples.en: The witness took an oath to tell the truth.
examples.zh: 证人宣誓说出真相。

examples.en: The government placed an embargo on foreign weapons.
examples.zh: 政府对外国武器实施了禁运。

examples.en: The soldier stood erect during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 仪式期间，士兵笔直地站着。

examples.en: The team worked efficiently and finished early.
examples.zh: 团队高效地工作，提前完成了任务。

examples.en: The dentist gave her a new tooth implant.
examples.zh: 牙医为她安装了一颗新的牙齿植入物。

examples.en: A deficiency of vitamin C can make you ill.
examples.zh: 缺乏维生素C会让你生病。

examples.en: My nephew is learning to ride a bike.
examples.zh: 我侄子正在学骑自行车。

examples.en: This is a fine vintage from a famous vineyard.
examples.zh: 这是一款来自著名葡萄园的好年份葡萄酒。

examples.en: Without my glasses, everything is just a blur.
examples.zh: 没有眼镜，一切都只是一片模糊。

examples.en: The school's enrollment grew this year.
examples.zh: 今年这所学校的注册人数增加了。

examples.en: The doctor gave me some dietary advice.
examples.zh: 医生给了我一些饮食方面的建议。

examples.en: Farmers spread fertilizer to help the crops grow.
examples.zh: 农民们撒肥料来帮助庄稼生长。

examples.en: The little girl believes a fairy lives in the garden.
examples.zh: 小女孩相信花园里住着一位仙女。

examples.en: The plane flew at a very high altitude.
examples.zh: 飞机在很高的高度飞行。

examples.en: The glare of the sun hurt my eyes.
examples.zh: 刺眼的阳光让我的眼睛很难受。

examples.en: She had to squint to read the small letters.
examples.zh: 她不得不眯起眼睛才能看清那些小字。

examples.en: He used a flashlight to find his keys in the dark.
examples.zh: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。

examples.en: There was a sense of urgency in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的声音里有一种紧迫感。

examples.en: The company started a new recruitment campaign.
examples.zh: 公司开始了一项新的招募活动。

examples.en: Keep a pen handy in case you need it.
examples.zh: 把笔放在手边，以防你需要用到。

examples.en: He was fired for making racist comments.
examples.zh: 他因发表种族主义言论而被解雇。

examples.en: I need to download the file before the meeting.
examples.zh: 我需要在会议前下载这个文件。

examples.en: The house was oddly quiet that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，房子里奇怪地安静。

examples.en: It is hard to differentiate the twin brothers.
examples.zh: 很难区分这对双胞胎兄弟。

examples.en: The two schools decided to collaborate on a project.
examples.zh: 两所学校决定在一个项目上合作。

examples.en: She won three games in succession.
examples.zh: 她连续赢了三场比赛。

examples.en: The waitress brought us water and menus.
examples.zh: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。

examples.en: This math problem is really tricky.
examples.zh: 这道数学题真的很难解。

examples.en: A large elk crossed the road in front of us.
examples.zh: 一只大麋鹿从我们前面穿过马路。

examples.en: Only a remnant of the old wall still stands.
examples.zh: 古老城墙只剩下一点残余还立在那里。

examples.en: The workers mixed cement to build the wall.
examples.zh: 工人们搅拌水泥来砌墙。

examples.en: He felt the decision was morally wrong.
examples.zh: 他觉得这个决定在道德上是错误的。

examples.en: The students had to recite the poem in class.
examples.zh: 学生们必须在课堂上背诵这首诗。

examples.en: The students share a communal kitchen.
examples.zh: 学生们共用一个公共厨房。

examples.en: They plan to situate the new school near the park.
examples.zh: 他们计划把新学校建在公园附近。

examples.en: He has been unemployed since the factory closed.
examples.zh: 自从工厂关闭后，他一直失业。

examples.en: I really love spicy Sichuan cuisine.
examples.zh: 我真的很喜欢辛辣的四川菜。

examples.en: Confucius was a great thinker of ancient China.
examples.zh: 孔子是古代中国伟大的思想家。

examples.en: The two boys like to wrestle on the grass.
examples.zh: 两个男孩喜欢在草地上摔跤。

examples.en: The radio signal was lost due to interference.
examples.zh: 由于干扰，无线电信号丢失了。

examples.en: Don't underestimate how hard this exam is.
examples.zh: 不要低估这场考试的难度。

examples.en: Too much rain can spoil the harvest.
examples.zh: 雨水太多会毁掉收成。

examples.en: We had eggs and bacon for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我们早餐吃了鸡蛋和熏猪肉。

examples.en: She showed great maturity for her young age.
examples.zh: 对于她这么小的年纪，她表现得非常成熟。

examples.en: The flood could devastate the whole village.
examples.zh: 洪水可能会摧毁整个村庄。

examples.en: Please read the last clause of the contract.
examples.zh: 请阅读合同的最后一项条款。

examples.en: The captain used stars to navigate the ship.
examples.zh: 船长靠星星来给船导航。

examples.en: The report was a collaborative effort by the team.
examples.zh: 这份报告是团队合作的成果。

examples.en: He looks healthy and robust after the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期之后他看起来健康又强壮。

examples.en: "Good night, darling," she said softly.
examples.zh: “晚安，亲爱的，”她轻声说道。

examples.en: The baby called out "mama" for the first time.
examples.zh: 宝宝第一次喊出了“妈妈”。

examples.en: Guests waited in the parlor for the host.
examples.zh: 客人们在会客室里等候主人。

examples.en: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday.
examples.zh: 学校张贴了一则关于假期的公告。

examples.en: The factory's waste harmed the river's ecology.
examples.zh: 工厂的废物破坏了河流的生态。

examples.en: They drove through the northwestern part of the country.
examples.zh: 他们驱车穿过这个国家的西北部。

examples.en: The army announced the deployment of new troops.
examples.zh: 军队宣布了新部队的部署。

examples.en: A nice scarf is a useful accessory in winter.
examples.zh: 一条漂亮的围巾是冬天有用的配饰。

examples.en: We had dinner on the terrace under the stars.
examples.zh: 我们在露台上的星空下吃了晚餐。

examples.en: The new manager wanted to keep continuity in the team.
examples.zh: 新经理想保持团队的连续性。

examples.en: He gave an indirect answer to my question.
examples.zh: 他对我的问题给出了一个间接的回答。

examples.en: They argue over petty things every day.
examples.zh: 他们每天都为琐碎的小事争吵。

examples.en: He has a bad temper and shouts a lot.
examples.zh: 他脾气很坏，经常大喊大叫。

examples.en: The cherry trees blossom in early spring.
examples.zh: 樱桃树在早春开花。

examples.en: She was genuinely happy for her friend.
examples.zh: 她真心为她的朋友感到高兴。

examples.en: The spacecraft landed safely on the moon.
examples.zh: 这艘宇宙飞船安全地降落在月球上。

examples.en: The generic medicine is much cheaper than the brand.
examples.zh: 这种通用药品比品牌药便宜得多。

examples.en: The process was slow because of bureaucratic rules.
examples.zh: 由于官僚的规定，这个过程很缓慢。

examples.en: She trained hard to run her first marathon.
examples.zh: 她刻苦训练，去跑她的第一个马拉松。

examples.en: Globalization has connected markets around the world.
examples.zh: 全球化把世界各地的市场连接了起来。

examples.en: He won a prestigious award for his research.
examples.zh: 他因研究获得了一个享有声望的奖项。

examples.en: The tight shoes caused her great discomfort.
examples.zh: 那双紧鞋让她非常不舒适。

examples.en: The roads were icy and very dangerous.
examples.zh: 道路结冰，非常危险。

examples.en: She put her books into her backpack.
examples.zh: 她把书放进背包里。

examples.en: The soldiers massacred many innocent villagers.
examples.zh: 士兵们屠杀了许多无辜的村民。

examples.en: Praise from his teacher was a spur to study harder.
examples.zh: 老师的表扬激励他更努力地学习。

examples.en: The soldiers hid inside a deep trench.
examples.zh: 士兵们躲在一条深深的战壕里。

examples.en: Any deviation from the plan must be reported.
examples.zh: 任何对计划的偏离都必须报告。

examples.en: She finds spirituality through quiet meditation.
examples.zh: 她通过安静的冥想找到精神上的寄托。

examples.en: The referee blew his whistle to stop the game.
examples.zh: 裁判吹响哨子，让比赛暂停。

examples.en: She added cinnamon to the warm apple pie.
examples.zh: 她在温热的苹果派里加了肉桂。

examples.en: Her devotion to her family is well known.
examples.zh: 她对家人的热爱是众所周知的。

examples.en: Good governance helps a country grow stronger.
examples.zh: 良好的治理有助于一个国家变得更强大。

examples.en: The truck runs on diesel, not gasoline.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车用柴油，而不是汽油。

examples.en: He loves astronomy and watches the stars at night.
examples.zh: 他热爱天文学，夜里观察星星。

examples.en: Please dress appropriately for the job interview.
examples.zh: 请为求职面试穿着得体。

examples.en: Driving so fast in the rain is simply insane.
examples.zh: 在雨中开这么快简直是疯了。

examples.en: There was an unpleasant smell in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里有一股令人不愉快的气味。

examples.en: The coach wrote every player's name on the roster.
examples.zh: 教练把每个球员的名字都写在花名册上。

examples.en: We saw a dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
examples.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具恐龙骨骼。

examples.en: Salmon swim upriver to spawn each year.
examples.zh: 鲑鱼每年逆流而上去产卵。

examples.en: My mother taught me how to sew a button.
examples.zh: 我妈妈教我如何缝纽扣。

examples.en: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the town.
examples.zh: 这场风暴给镇子造成了严重的破坏。

examples.en: The court decided to indict him for theft.
examples.zh: 法院决定以盗窃罪起诉他。

examples.en: The children came home with muddy shoes.
examples.zh: 孩子们穿着沾满泥的鞋子回家。

examples.en: The sad film moved her profoundly.
examples.zh: 这部悲伤的电影深深地打动了她。

examples.en: Loud noise is an occupational hazard for them.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音对他们来说是一种职业危害。

examples.en: A green turtle swam slowly across the pond.
examples.zh: 一只绿海龟慢慢地游过池塘。

examples.en: The jazz trio played beautiful music tonight.
examples.zh: 这个爵士三重奏今晚演奏了美妙的音乐。

examples.en: We took the ferry across the river.
examples.zh: 我们乘渡船过河。

examples.zh: 他用一根长杆来获得更大的杠杆作用。

examples.en: The candy made my fingers sticky.
examples.zh: 糖果把我的手指弄得黏糊糊的。

examples.en: The singer made a great comeback this year.
examples.zh: 这位歌手今年成功复出。

examples.en: He left school in June and worked thereafter.
examples.zh: 他六月离开学校，此后便开始工作。

examples.en: Don't forget the renewal of your passport.
examples.zh: 别忘了护照的更新。

examples.zh: 战后这个国家陷入了混乱。

examples.en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
examples.zh: 许多鸟为了过冬而向南迁徙。

examples.zh: 她把这首歌练到了完美。

examples.zh: 医生给我开了转诊到专科医生的介绍。

examples.en: The teacher chose students randomly to answer.
examples.zh: 老师随机挑选学生来回答。

examples.en: She is keen to learn how to swim.
examples.zh: 她渴望学会游泳。

examples.zh: 婚礼仪式持续了大约一个小时。

examples.zh: 母狮保护她的后代免受危险。

examples.en: He has a strong mathematical mind.
examples.zh: 他有很强的数学头脑。

examples.en: The child has an imaginary friend.
examples.zh: 这个孩子有一个想象中的朋友。

examples.en: Use a map to orient yourself in the new city.
examples.zh: 用地图在这座新城市里确定方向。

examples.en: The old letters are kept in the city archive.
examples.zh: 这些旧信件保存在市档案馆里。

examples.en: All workers must adhere to the safety rules.
examples.zh: 所有工人都必须遵守安全规定。

examples.en: Please keep your receipt in case you return it.
examples.zh: 请保留收据，以防你要退货。

examples.en: The town has changed radically over ten years.
examples.zh: 这个镇子在十年间彻底改变了。

examples.en: Tall stone pillars held up the old temple roof.
examples.zh: 高大的石柱支撑着古庙的屋顶。

examples.en: She packed clean underwear for the trip.
examples.zh: 她为旅行收拾了干净的内衣。

examples.en: The river suffered from serious chemical contamination.
examples.zh: 这条河遭受了严重的化学污染。
